name: EE — Sofia Call Outcomes → Phillips desk + Meta CAPI (LIVE)
source: proposed patch — NOT applied to Make
design: xfer:{call_id} changes meaning from CLAIMED to DELIVERED and is written only after an email returns a message id.
Every record written by the current design is already keyed xfer:{call_id}, so on deploy every historical call still reads as delivered and is never re-emailed. That is the no-replay guarantee.
xferlock:{call_id} is a new short-lived claim that stops two overlapping runs double-sending, and expires so a crashed run can be retried.
Email modules gain a resume handler so a send failure no longer aborts the execution before the receipt is recorded and no longer counts toward maxErrors (3).

trigger.retryHorizonNote: Unchanged on purpose. The 25-minute window still bounds retries to roughly two cycles; see P2 sweeper in README.md.

steps.label: Already DELIVERED? (same key as before → historical records suppress)
NEW — no live claim, or previous attempt is >10m stale
REPURPOSED (was 'Mark confirmed') — take the claim, do not assert delivery
Ad lookup (BigQuery) — sanitize leadgen_id, see README
PI/MVA desk — resume so the receipt step still runs
NEW — DELIVERED marker, only when the send returned a message id
NEW — auditable failure trail; today a failure leaves no record at all
